```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r load-upstream}
load_rds_list("05_wgcna_soft_threshold")
gene_module_df <- load_rds_object("06_gene_module_df")
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step 4. Re-rank WGCNA modules by TNL/CNL/RNL enrichment
## Purpose:
##   Do not rank modules only by the number of DE NLRs.
##   Instead, calculate module size, NLR density, fold enrichment,
##   and hypergeometric-test FDR.
##
## Required input:
##   1. gene_module_df
##      columns: Gene, Module
##      or moduleColors + wgcna_data
##
##   2. NLR master table from previous steps:
##      Preferred:
##      log2FC_threshold_sensitivity_TNL_CNL_RNL/NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv
##      or:
##      NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
##
## Main output:
##   Directory:
##   WGCNA_TCR_NLR_module_enrichment
############################################################


## -----------------------------
## 0. Settings
## -----------------------------

outdir <- analysis_file("WGCNA_TCR_NLR_module_enrichment")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

top_n_modules <- 20
min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_priority <- 2
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05

tcr_levels <- c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL")

type_cols <- c(
  TNL = "#7B3294",
  CNL = "#008837",
  RNL = "#E66101"
)

save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 7, height = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

as_logical_safe <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  
  x_chr <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES", "Y") ~ TRUE,
    x_chr %in% c("FALSE", "F", "0", "NO", "N") ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
}

safe_module_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_")
}


## -----------------------------
## 1. Prepare WGCNA module table
## -----------------------------

if (!exists("gene_module_df")) {
  
  if (exists("moduleColors") && exists("wgcna_data")) {
    
    gene_module_df <- tibble(
      Gene = colnames(wgcna_data),
      Module = as.character(moduleColors)
    )
    
    message("gene_module_df was created from moduleColors and colnames(wgcna_data).")
    
  } else {
    
    stop(
      "Cannot find gene_module_df. Please prepare a data frame with columns Gene and Module, ",
      "or provide moduleColors + wgcna_data."
    )
  }
}

gene_module_df_clean <- as.data.frame(gene_module_df) %>%
  as_tibble()

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(gene_module_df_clean)) {
  colnames(gene_module_df_clean)[1] <- "Gene"
}

if (!"Module" %in% colnames(gene_module_df_clean)) {
  
  possible_module_cols <- c(
    "module", "ModuleColor", "moduleColor",
    "colors", "moduleColors"
  )
  
  matched_module_col <- intersect(possible_module_cols, colnames(gene_module_df_clean))
  
  if (length(matched_module_col) >= 1) {
    gene_module_df_clean <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
      dplyr::rename(Module = all_of(matched_module_col[1]))
  } else {
    colnames(gene_module_df_clean)[2] <- "Module"
  }
}

gene_module_df_clean <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Module = as.character(Module) %>% str_trim()
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene), Gene != "", !is.na(Module), Module != "") %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Module)

cat("\n===== WGCNA module table check =====\n")
cat("Total WGCNA genes:", nrow(gene_module_df_clean), "\n")
cat("Total WGCNA modules:", n_distinct(gene_module_df_clean$Module), "\n\n")

print(
  gene_module_df_clean %>%
    dplyr::count(Module, name = "ModuleSize") %>%
    arrange(desc(ModuleSize)) %>%
    head(10)
)


## -----------------------------
## 2. Read TNL/CNL/RNL NLR master table
## -----------------------------

candidate_master_files <- c(
  analysis_file("log2FC_threshold_sensitivity_TNL_CNL_RNL", "NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv"),
  "NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv",
  analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)

existing_master_files <- candidate_master_files[file.exists(candidate_master_files)]

if (length(existing_master_files) >= 1) {
  
  nlr_master_file <- existing_master_files[1]
  
  nlr_master <- read_tsv(
    nlr_master_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  message("Using NLR master file: ", nlr_master_file)
  
} else if (exists("nlr_master")) {
  
  nlr_master <- as.data.frame(nlr_master) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  message("Using object 'nlr_master' from current R environment.")
  
} else {
  
  stop(
    "Cannot find NLR master table. Please provide one of these files:\n",
    paste(candidate_master_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  colnames(nlr_master)[1] <- "Gene"
}

if (!"Type" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  stop("NLR master table must contain a column named Type.")
}

nlr_master <- as.data.frame(nlr_master) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Type = as.character(Type) %>% str_trim() %>% str_to_upper()
  ) %>%
  filter(Type %in% tcr_levels) %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels))

nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("Module")) %>%
  left_join(gene_module_df_clean, by = "Gene")

if (!"DE_LRT" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  
  if (!"padj" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
    stop("NLR master table must contain either DE_LRT or padj.")
  }
  
  nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
    mutate(
      Has_padj = !is.na(padj),
      DE_LRT = case_when(
        Has_padj & padj < 0.05 ~ TRUE,
        Has_padj & padj >= 0.05 ~ FALSE,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    )
  
} else {
  
  nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
    mutate(
      DE_LRT = as_logical_safe(DE_LRT),
      Has_padj = if ("Has_padj" %in% colnames(.)) {
        as_logical_safe(Has_padj)
      } else if ("padj" %in% colnames(.)) {
        !is.na(padj)
      } else {
        !is.na(DE_LRT)
      }
    )
}

cat("\n===== TNL/CNL/RNL master table check =====\n")
print(
  nlr_master %>%
    group_by(Type) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_TCR_NLR = n(),
      In_WGCNA = sum(!is.na(Module)),
      Tested_NLR = sum(Has_padj, na.rm = TRUE),
      DE_LRT_NLR = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      DE_LRT_NLR_in_WGCNA = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE & !is.na(Module), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)


## -----------------------------
## 3. Define WGCNA background and NLR sets
## -----------------------------

wgcna_universe <- gene_module_df_clean$Gene
bg_genes <- length(wgcna_universe)

all_TCR_genes_in_wgcna <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(Gene %in% wgcna_universe) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

DE_TCR_genes_in_wgcna <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, Gene %in% wgcna_universe) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

cat("\n===== Background definition =====\n")
cat("WGCNA background genes:", bg_genes, "\n")
cat("All TNL/CNL/RNL genes in WGCNA:", length(all_TCR_genes_in_wgcna), "\n")
cat("LRT-DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes in WGCNA:", length(DE_TCR_genes_in_wgcna), "\n\n")


## -----------------------------
## 4. Module-level enrichment analysis
## -----------------------------

module_size <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
  dplyr::count(Module, name = "ModuleSize")

module_tcr_counts <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
  left_join(
    nlr_master %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Type, DE_LRT),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(
    All_TCR_NLR = sum(!is.na(Type)),
    DE_TCR_NLR = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    TNL_total = sum(Type == "TNL", na.rm = TRUE),
    CNL_total = sum(Type == "CNL", na.rm = TRUE),
    RNL_total = sum(Type == "RNL", na.rm = TRUE),
    TNL_DE = sum(Type == "TNL" & DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    CNL_DE = sum(Type == "CNL" & DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    RNL_DE = sum(Type == "RNL" & DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

module_enrichment <- module_size %>%
  left_join(module_tcr_counts, by = "Module") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        All_TCR_NLR, DE_TCR_NLR,
        TNL_total, CNL_total, RNL_total,
        TNL_DE, CNL_DE, RNL_DE
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),
    
    BgGenes = bg_genes,
    BgAll_TCR_NLR = length(all_TCR_genes_in_wgcna),
    BgDE_TCR_NLR = length(DE_TCR_genes_in_wgcna),
    
    All_TCR_density = All_TCR_NLR / ModuleSize,
    DE_TCR_density = DE_TCR_NLR / ModuleSize,
    
    BgAll_TCR_density = BgAll_TCR_NLR / BgGenes,
    BgDE_TCR_density = BgDE_TCR_NLR / BgGenes,
    
    Expected_All_TCR_NLR = ModuleSize * BgAll_TCR_density,
    Expected_DE_TCR_NLR = ModuleSize * BgDE_TCR_density,
    
    FoldEnrichment_All_TCR = if_else(
      Expected_All_TCR_NLR > 0,
      All_TCR_NLR / Expected_All_TCR_NLR,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR = if_else(
      Expected_DE_TCR_NLR > 0,
      DE_TCR_NLR / Expected_DE_TCR_NLR,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    p_over_All_TCR = phyper(
      q = All_TCR_NLR - 1,
      m = BgAll_TCR_NLR,
      n = BgGenes - BgAll_TCR_NLR,
      k = ModuleSize,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    ),
    
    p_over_DE_TCR = phyper(
      q = DE_TCR_NLR - 1,
      m = BgDE_TCR_NLR,
      n = BgGenes - BgDE_TCR_NLR,
      k = ModuleSize,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    ),
    
    FDR_All_TCR = p.adjust(p_over_All_TCR, method = "BH"),
    FDR_DE_TCR = p.adjust(p_over_DE_TCR, method = "BH"),
    
    minus_log10_FDR_DE_TCR = -log10(pmax(FDR_DE_TCR, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    
    Priority = case_when(
      FDR_DE_TCR < fdr_cutoff &
        DE_TCR_NLR >= min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_priority ~ "High_priority_DE_TCR_enriched",
      
      p_over_DE_TCR < 0.05 &
        DE_TCR_NLR >= min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_priority ~ "Nominal_DE_TCR_enriched",
      
      DE_TCR_NLR >= min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_priority &
        FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR > 1 ~ "Count_density_supported",
      
      DE_TCR_NLR > 0 ~ "Contains_DE_TCR_NLR",
      
      TRUE ~ "No_DE_TCR_NLR"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    FDR_DE_TCR,
    desc(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR),
    desc(DE_TCR_density),
    desc(DE_TCR_NLR),
    ModuleSize
  ) %>%
  mutate(Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment = row_number())

write_tsv(
  module_enrichment,
  file.path(outdir, "WGCNA_module_TCR_NLR_enrichment.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Top WGCNA modules ranked by DE TNL/CNL/RNL enrichment =====\n")
print(
  module_enrichment %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      Expected_DE_TCR_NLR,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      p_over_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority
    ) %>%
    head(20)
)


## -----------------------------
## 5. Compare previously focused modules
## -----------------------------

previous_focus_modules <- c("turquoise", "blue", "red")

previous_focus_summary <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(Module %in% previous_focus_modules) %>%
  arrange(Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment)

write_tsv(
  previous_focus_summary,
  file.path(outdir, "Previous_focus_modules_blue_turquoise_red_reranked.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== blue / turquoise / red after enrichment-based re-ranking =====\n")
print(
  previous_focus_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      p_over_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority,
      TNL_DE,
      CNL_DE,
      RNL_DE
    )
)


## -----------------------------
## 6. Type-specific enrichment: TNL, CNL, RNL separately
## -----------------------------

bg_type_de <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, Gene %in% wgcna_universe) %>%
  dplyr::count(Type, name = "BgTypeDE")

module_type_de <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, Gene %in% wgcna_universe) %>%
  dplyr::count(Module, Type, name = "ModuleTypeDE")

type_specific_enrichment <- expand_grid(
  Module = unique(gene_module_df_clean$Module),
  Type = tcr_levels
) %>%
  left_join(module_size, by = "Module") %>%
  left_join(bg_type_de, by = "Type") %>%
  left_join(module_type_de, by = c("Module", "Type")) %>%
  mutate(
    BgTypeDE = replace_na(BgTypeDE, 0),
    ModuleTypeDE = replace_na(ModuleTypeDE, 0),
    
    ExpectedTypeDE = ModuleSize * BgTypeDE / bg_genes,
    
    TypeDE_density = ModuleTypeDE / ModuleSize,
    
    FoldEnrichment_TypeDE = if_else(
      ExpectedTypeDE > 0,
      ModuleTypeDE / ExpectedTypeDE,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    p_over_TypeDE = if_else(
      BgTypeDE > 0,
      phyper(
        q = ModuleTypeDE - 1,
        m = BgTypeDE,
        n = bg_genes - BgTypeDE,
        k = ModuleSize,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(FDR_TypeDE = p.adjust(p_over_TypeDE, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Type, FDR_TypeDE, desc(FoldEnrichment_TypeDE), desc(ModuleTypeDE))


## -----------------------------
## 7. Export NLR gene lists for enriched modules
## -----------------------------

top_modules <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(DE_TCR_NLR > 0) %>%
  arrange(
    FDR_DE_TCR,
    desc(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR),
    desc(DE_TCR_density),
    desc(DE_TCR_NLR)
  ) %>%
  head(top_n_modules) %>%
  pull(Module)

write_lines(
  top_modules,
  file.path(outdir, "Top_modules_by_DE_TCR_NLR_enrichment.txt")
)

top_module_all_genes <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
  filter(Module %in% top_modules) %>%
  arrange(match(Module, top_modules), Gene)

top_module_DE_TCR_NLRs <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(Module %in% top_modules, DE_LRT == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(match(Module, top_modules), Type, Gene)

top_module_all_TCR_NLRs <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(Module %in% top_modules) %>%
  arrange(match(Module, top_modules), Type, Gene)

write_tsv(
  top_module_all_genes,
  file.path(outdir, "Top_modules_all_genes.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  top_module_DE_TCR_NLRs,
  file.path(outdir, "Top_modules_DE_TCR_NLRs.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  top_module_all_TCR_NLRs,
  file.path(outdir, "Top_modules_all_TCR_NLRs.tsv")
)

module_list_dir <- file.path(outdir, "per_module_gene_lists")
dir.create(module_list_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (mod in top_modules) {
  
  mod_safe <- safe_module_name(mod)
  
  mod_all_genes <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
    filter(Module == mod) %>%
    pull(Gene)
  
  mod_DE_TCR_NLRs <- nlr_master %>%
    filter(Module == mod, DE_LRT == TRUE) %>%
    arrange(Type, Gene)
  
  mod_all_TCR_NLRs <- nlr_master %>%
    filter(Module == mod) %>%
    arrange(Type, Gene)
  
  write_lines(
    mod_all_genes,
    file.path(module_list_dir, paste0("Module_", mod_safe, "_all_genes.txt"))
  )
  
  write_tsv(
    mod_DE_TCR_NLRs,
    file.path(module_list_dir, paste0("Module_", mod_safe, "_DE_TCR_NLRs.tsv"))
  )
  
  write_tsv(
    mod_all_TCR_NLRs,
    file.path(module_list_dir, paste0("Module_", mod_safe, "_all_TCR_NLRs.tsv"))
  )
}


## -----------------------------
## EXTRA: Inline display of key enrichment tables
## -----------------------------

cat("\n===== Type-specific enrichment: ALL modules with ModuleTypeDE > 0 (top 30) =====\n")
print(
  type_specific_enrichment %>%
    dplyr::filter(ModuleTypeDE > 0) %>%
    dplyr::select(Type, Module, ModuleSize, ModuleTypeDE,
                  ExpectedTypeDE, FoldEnrichment_TypeDE,
                  p_over_TypeDE, FDR_TypeDE) %>%
    head(30),
  n = 30
)

cat("\n===== Top 5 modules per type (TNL / CNL / RNL) =====\n")
print(
  type_specific_enrichment %>%
    dplyr::filter(ModuleTypeDE > 0) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Type) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(FDR_TypeDE, desc(FoldEnrichment_TypeDE)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Type, Module, ModuleSize, ModuleTypeDE,
                  FoldEnrichment_TypeDE, p_over_TypeDE, FDR_TypeDE),
  n = 30
)

cat("\n===== High-priority modules =====\n")
hp <- module_enrichment %>%
  dplyr::filter(Priority == "High_priority_DE_TCR_enriched") %>%
  dplyr::select(Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment, Module, ModuleSize, DE_TCR_NLR,
                FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR, FDR_DE_TCR, TNL_DE, CNL_DE, RNL_DE)
if (nrow(hp) > 0) print(hp) else cat("No module passed High_priority threshold.\n")

## -----------------------------
## 8. Figure 1:
##    Enrichment bubble plot for top modules
## -----------------------------

plot_top <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(Module %in% top_modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Module = factor(Module, levels = rev(top_modules)),
    FDR_plot = pmax(FDR_DE_TCR, .Machine$double.xmin)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(
  plot_top,
  aes(
    x = FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
    y = Module,
    size = DE_TCR_NLR,
    color = -log10(FDR_plot)
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.5, 9)) +
  labs(
    title = "WGCNA modules ranked by DE TNL/CNL/RNL enrichment",
    subtitle = "Bubble size = DE TCR NLR count; color = -log10(FDR)",
    x = "Fold enrichment of DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes",
    y = "WGCNA module",
    size = "DE TCR NLRs",
    color = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p1)

save_plot(
  p1,
  "Fig1_WGCNA_module_DE_TCR_NLR_enrichment_bubble",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)


## -----------------------------
## 9. Figure 2:
##    Count vs density comparison
## -----------------------------

plot_count_density <- plot_top %>%
  dplyr::select(Module, ModuleSize, DE_TCR_NLR, DE_TCR_density, FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR, FDR_DE_TCR) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(DE_TCR_NLR, DE_TCR_density),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      DE_TCR_NLR = "DE TCR NLR count",
      DE_TCR_density = "DE TCR NLR density"
    ),
    Module = factor(Module, levels = rev(top_modules))
  )

p2 <- ggplot(
  plot_count_density,
  aes(x = Value, y = Module)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Module ranking should consider both NLR count and NLR density",
    x = NULL,
    y = "WGCNA module"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p2)

save_plot(
  p2,
  "Fig2_WGCNA_module_count_vs_density",
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)


## -----------------------------
## 10. Figure 3:
##     TNL/CNL/RNL composition heatmap
## -----------------------------

type_module_heatmap_df <- top_module_DE_TCR_NLRs %>%
  dplyr::count(Module, Type, name = "DE_NLR_count") %>%
  complete(
    Module = top_modules,
    Type = factor(tcr_levels, levels = tcr_levels),
    fill = list(DE_NLR_count = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Module = factor(Module, levels = top_modules),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)
  )

p3 <- ggplot(
  type_module_heatmap_df,
  aes(x = Module, y = Type, fill = DE_NLR_count)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(DE_NLR_count > 0, DE_NLR_count, "")),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#2166AC"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Structural-class composition of DE NLRs in enriched WGCNA modules",
    x = "WGCNA module",
    y = "NLR structural class",
    fill = "DE NLR count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p3)

save_plot(
  p3,
  "Fig3_TNL_CNL_RNL_composition_in_top_WGCNA_modules",
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8
)


## -----------------------------
## 11. Figure 4:
##     Module size vs DE TCR density
## -----------------------------

scatter_df <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(DE_TCR_NLR > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    label_module = ifelse(
      Module %in% top_modules[1:min(10, length(top_modules))],
      Module,
      ""
    )
  )

p4 <- ggplot(
  scatter_df,
  aes(
    x = ModuleSize,
    y = DE_TCR_density,
    size = DE_TCR_NLR,
    color = FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label_module),
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 0.3,
    size = 3,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Large modules may have many NLRs but low NLR density",
    x = "Module size, log10 scale",
    y = "DE TCR NLR density",
    size = "DE TCR NLRs",
    color = "Fold enrichment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p4)

save_plot(
  p4,
  "Fig4_module_size_vs_DE_TCR_NLR_density",
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5
)


## -----------------------------
## 12. Figure 5:
##     Previous modules comparison
## -----------------------------

if (nrow(previous_focus_summary) > 0) {
  
  previous_plot_df <- previous_focus_summary %>%
    mutate(
      Module = factor(Module, levels = previous_focus_modules),
      label = paste0(
        "Rank ", Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
        "\n",
        DE_TCR_NLR, " DE NLRs",
        "\nFE=", round(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR, 2)
      )
    )
  
  p5 <- ggplot(
    previous_plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Module,
      y = FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      size = DE_TCR_NLR,
      fill = DE_TCR_density
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = -0.2,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(previous_plot_df$FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Re-ranking of previously focused WGCNA modules",
      subtitle = "blue / turquoise / red compared by enrichment instead of raw NLR count",
      x = "WGCNA module",
      y = "Fold enrichment of DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes",
      size = "DE TCR NLRs",
      fill = "DE TCR density"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  print(p5)
  
  save_plot(
    p5,
    "Fig5_previous_modules_blue_turquoise_red_reranked",
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
}


## -----------------------------
## 13. Export concise summary
## -----------------------------

high_priority_modules <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(Priority == "High_priority_DE_TCR_enriched")

nominal_modules <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(Priority %in% c("High_priority_DE_TCR_enriched", "Nominal_DE_TCR_enriched"))

best_module <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(DE_TCR_NLR > 0) %>%
  arrange(
    FDR_DE_TCR,
    desc(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR),
    desc(DE_TCR_density),
    desc(DE_TCR_NLR)
  ) %>%
  head(1)

summary_file <- file.path(outdir, "WGCNA_TCR_NLR_module_enrichment_summary.txt")

sink(summary_file)

cat("WGCNA module re-ranking by TNL/CNL/RNL enrichment\n")
cat("=================================================\n\n")

cat("1. Background\n")
cat("WGCNA background genes:", bg_genes, "\n")
cat("All TNL/CNL/RNL genes in WGCNA:", length(all_TCR_genes_in_wgcna), "\n")
cat("LRT-DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes in WGCNA:", length(DE_TCR_genes_in_wgcna), "\n\n")

cat("2. Top modules ranked by DE TNL/CNL/RNL enrichment\n")
print(
  module_enrichment %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      Expected_DE_TCR_NLR,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      p_over_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority,
      TNL_DE,
      CNL_DE,
      RNL_DE
    ) %>%
    head(30)
)
cat("\n")

cat("3. Previously focused modules: blue / turquoise / red\n")
print(
  previous_focus_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      p_over_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority,
      TNL_DE,
      CNL_DE,
      RNL_DE
    )
)
cat("\n")

cat("4. Type-specific enrichment, top records\n")
print(
  type_specific_enrichment %>%
    filter(ModuleTypeDE > 0) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Type,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      ModuleTypeDE,
      ExpectedTypeDE,
      FoldEnrichment_TypeDE,
      p_over_TypeDE,
      FDR_TypeDE
    ) %>%
    head(50)
)
cat("\n")

cat("5. High-priority modules\n")
if (nrow(high_priority_modules) > 0) {
  print(
    high_priority_modules %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
        Module,
        ModuleSize,
        DE_TCR_NLR,
        DE_TCR_density,
        FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
        FDR_DE_TCR,
        TNL_DE,
        CNL_DE,
        RNL_DE
      )
  )
} else {
  cat("No module passed FDR <", fdr_cutoff, "with at least", min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_priority, "DE TCR NLRs.\n")
  cat("Use nominally enriched modules and density-supported modules for exploratory interpretation.\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("6. Best module by enrichment ranking\n")
print(
  best_module %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      Expected_DE_TCR_NLR,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      p_over_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority,
      TNL_DE,
      CNL_DE,
      RNL_DE
    )
)
cat("\n")

cat("7. Suggested interpretation\n")
cat(
  "Modules should be prioritized by enrichment statistics, not raw NLR count alone. ",
  "A large module can contain many NLRs simply because it contains many genes, whereas a smaller module with high DE TCR NLR density and high fold enrichment is more likely to represent an NLR-centered response module.\n",
  sep = ""
)

sink()
```
